summary_1line: Bhishma explains that Chastisement (Danda) is the divine force of justice and punishment sustaining social order, righteousness, and cosmic balance.

image_candidates.scene_text: The deity Chastisement appears as a dark, fire-like being with many eyes, four arms, eight legs, matted hair, and weapons in every hand.
Bhishma lies on his bed of arrows while Yudhishthira stands beside him listening to the discourse on the nature of Chastisement.
The fierce god of Chastisement strides across the world wielding swords, maces, tridents, and bows, striking down disorder.
